question: Should OpenClaw expose queue/workload state to agents, and if so which lane and cross-agent metadata may an agent read through a shared snapshot contract?
rationale: This is a new agent capability with operational metadata and authorization implications; source-level implementation cannot safely choose its visibility boundary or public API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve scoped agent snapshot
options.body: Expose only caller-authorized lane totals and dispatch-relevant capacity through a shared read-only snapshot backend, then register a focused agent tool.

options.title: Operator diagnostics only
options.body: Keep queue snapshots limited to operator CLI/RPC/UI diagnostics and document that agents must use existing session tools for dispatch decisions.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Leave the request open until queue observability and cross-agent workload visibility have a broader product owner and authorization design.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped agent snapshot
recommendation.body: Expose only caller-authorized lane totals and dispatch-relevant capacity through a shared read-only snapshot backend, then register a focused agent tool.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history places this contributor across the queue, gateway-lane, and agent-tool surfaces where the product boundary would be implemented.
